title: EXEC SQL CALL of a stored procedure recorded as a COBOL dynamic CALL
shapes: EXEC SQL / CALL PRODPROC.CUSTBAL / (:CUST-ID, :CUST-BAL) / END-EXEC (schema-qualified, multi-line)
EXEC SQL CALL CUSTAUDT END-EXEC (unqualified, one line)
asserts: Both are SQL statements with verb CALL and the procedure name; neither is a COBOL CALL site or a call edge.

citations.quote: The CALL statement invokes a stored procedure. ... This statement can be embedded in an application program.

notes: Era 2: the earliest era whose product has the construct (COBOL 85 / COBOL II era or later (inline PERFORM, scope terminators, nested programs) or EXEC SQL / CSD (RDO), era 2 in the #5118 table). Cited to the 6.x manuals only; no release-specific manual is cited, so no release is set.
